narrative.title: The Render Pipeline Scheduler
narrative.scenario: A graphics engine chains a sequence of image transforms whose intermediate buffers have known dimensions. Applying transforms in different groupings changes how many pixel-multiply operations the GPU performs, since pairing buffers incurs a cost proportional to their shared edges. The pipeline tuner must pick the association order that minimizes total scalar work.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer N and an array arr of N integers, where matrix i has dimensions arr[i-1] x arr[i] (so there are N-1 matrices).
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply the whole chain.

hintLevels: Level 1: Split the chain at every possible final multiplication point and take the cheapest split.
Level 2: dp[i][j] = min over k of arr[i-1]*arr[k]*arr[j] + dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j]; single matrices cost 0.
Level 3: Fill by increasing chain length rather than plain index order so subproblems exist before use.
